meta.calibrator_fitting: cross-fitted on the training split (5 folds); never on calibration rows
meta.guarantee: For new questions drawn i.i.d. from the calibration distribution (PubMedQA expert-labelled questions) and answered by the same pipeline, P(selective risk <= alpha) >= 1 - delta over the draw of the calibration set, under the monotone-risk condition stated in primum.uncertainty.conformal. For the deployed bundle the PubMedQA questions it covers are its held-out rows only; the rest were fitted or certified on. For free-form chat questions the threshold is an operating point, not a guarantee.

intervals.coverage, risk, threshold, set metrics: mean over repeats and central 95% range of the per-repeat values

calibration.source: deployed model's calibrated P(correct). p_correct/correct: the calibration rows the deployed thresholds were certified on (in-sample for the threshold). heldout: rows never used to fit, calibrate or certify (out-of-sample).
